summary: The Engrave task panel gains controls for Cut pattern, Sorting, Reverse and Approximation alongside the existing Start at vertex spinbox, exposing already-existing properties in the panel.

pages.reason: Gui/Resources/panels/PageOpEngraveEdit.ui: adds Cut pattern and Sorting combo boxes plus Reverse and Approximation checkboxes to the operation page; Path/Op/Gui/Engrave.py getFields/setFields wire them to CutPattern, SortingMode, Reverse, Approximation. Enumeration values and defaults are unchanged (Bidirectional remains default), so Properties stays as is.
